build_command: docker run --rm --network none --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -e CCACHE_DISABLE=1 -v {repo_root}:{repo_root} -w {repo_root} openroad/flow-ubuntu22.04-dev:latest bash -lc 'cmake -S {source_dir} -B {build_dir} -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DBUILD_GUI=OFF -DENABLE_TESTS=ON -DENABLE_GPU=OFF -DLINK_TIME_OPTIMIZATION=OFF -DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=OFF -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER= -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER= -DFETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_FMT={source_dir}/third-party/slang-elab/third_party/fmt -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fno-lto -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fno-lto -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fno-lto" -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fno-lto" && cmake --build {build_dir} --target openroad -j {jobs}'
unit_test_command: docker run --rm --network none --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -v {repo_root}:{repo_root} -w {repo_root} openroad/flow-ubuntu22.04-dev:latest ctest --test-dir {build_dir} --output-on-failure -R '^dpl\.(mirror1|mirror2|mirror3|mirror_edge_spacing)\.(py|tcl)$'
flow_command: docker run --rm --network none --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -v {repo_root}:{repo_root} -w {orfs_root}/flow openroad/flow-ubuntu22.04-dev:latest bash -lc 'variant=evolve_{candidate_id}_r{replica}; make DESIGN_CONFIG={design_config} FLOW_VARIANT=$variant clean_all && GPL_RANDOM_SEED={flow_seed} GRT_SEED={flow_seed} OR_SEED={flow_seed} OPENROAD_EXE={openroad_executable} YOSYS_EXE=/usr/local/bin/yosys KLAYOUT_CMD=/usr/bin/klayout make DESIGN_CONFIG={design_config} FLOW_VARIANT=$variant all && mkdir -p reports/{platform}/{design_name}/$variant && echo designs/{platform}/{design_name} > reports/{platform}/{design_name}/$variant/design-dir.txt && /usr/bin/python3 util/genMetrics.py -d {design_name} -p {platform} -v $variant --logs logs/{platform}/{design_name}/$variant --reports reports/{platform}/{design_name}/$variant --results results/{platform}/{design_name}/$variant -o reports/{platform}/{design_name}/$variant/metadata.json'
